scenario_description:
Objective: Finish loading tomorrow morning's Railyard market booth without turning the remaining clay crates into hand-carry trips.
Emerging Need: The packing session is already underway when the rolling wagon fails, leaving boxed ware staged but no usable way to move it to the car.
Decision Context: Saved load-ergonomics guidance distinguishes an acceptable wagon fallback from improvising, while current schedule and store notices define the short remaining hold window.
Consequence: A suitable rolling replacement secured in time can complete the interrupted load-out before the market vehicle-access deadline. Once that deadline passes with the crates still at home, recovery cannot preserve this market opening; later equipment planning remains possible.

parameter.title: Railyard Spring Craft Market load-in
parameter.description: Vehicle unload for booth 18 before the market opens at 9:00; finished ware should be packed the prior afternoon.

parameter.subject: Sunday maker load-in vehicle window
parameter.body: Confirmed for booth 18. Please complete vehicle unloading by 8:00 a.m. Sunday; after that, vehicles move to the public lot and only hand-carry access remains from parking. The plaza crew cannot move vendors' boxed inventory.

parameter.content: Starting the market load-out now. Folding wagon is open, first mug crate is on it, and I'm trying to get the four-crate hallway stack into the car before dinner.

The wagon's front axle pin just snapped when I lifted the first crate over the threshold. The wheel won't stay on, so I can't roll any more crates to the car, and the boxed ware is still sitting in the hallway.

parameter.subject: Saturday counter stock note: folding studio wagons
parameter.body: For local educators: one 150-lb folding studio wagon is available for a no-prepayment hold until 5:15 p.m. today. Reply before 5:15 if you want the counter to tag it for pickup before close; no Sunday pickup window is available.

parameter.content: The 08:00 market vehicle-unloading window has closed. My finished-ware crates are still boxed at home; the broken wagon was not replaced and I have not loaded the car. I cannot set up booth 18 for this opening. I am leaving the crates here rather than carrying them by hand.
